slug.description: Output directory name. Defaults to the config file name.

crs.description: "auto" (UTM zone from centroid) or an EPSG code such as "EPSG:6677".

orientation.description: auto: align cuts to the building's main axis; north: grid north; number: rotation in degrees.

footprint_follows_map.description: The footprint (a GeoJSON file) and the floors' `outline` files were drawn from the floor maps, so `nudge-map` / `mapbox-footprint --realign` move them together with the maps and plans (default: the footprint is the real shape and stays put).

name_template.description: e.g. "{level}F"; used for floors expanded from levels.

copy_from.description: Copy rooms (and plan) from this level.

outline.description: GeoJSON (WGS84) polygon this floor is limited to, relative to the config file — e.g. a tower's OSM building:part. Everything outside it is not part of the floor; ratios are shares of this area.

outline_clip.description: Default true: the outline is cut to the building footprint. False: the outline is the floor's own shape and may stick out of the footprint (a floor drawn from a floor map that disagrees with the footprint).

plan.description: GeoJSON (WGS84) of rooms with real shapes, relative to the config file. Features need properties.id and properties.name (optional: category, color, source, confidence, void). Ratio rooms then divide the remaining area; anything left becomes a common-area room.

basemap.description: A floor-map image shown under this floor in the preview (overrides a plan's own basemap). Written from `main.py basemap` / `main.py align` output.

image.description: Image path relative to the config file (e.g. plans/<slug>/maps/3F.png) or an http(s) URL.

corners.description: [lng, lat] of the image's top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left.

source.description: provenance source id of the image

alignment.description: How the corners were found (mode, pairs, rms_m); kept for reference.

auto_corners.description: The automatic placement before the first point-pair alignment; `main.py align --reset` (the preview's 「自動配置に戻す」) restores it.

category.description: retail | restaurant | office | lobby | service | circulation | connector (stairs, elevators, escalators) | parking | meeting | hall | other (free text allowed)

ratio.description: Share of the whole floor area.

flat.description: Draw at floor level only instead of full ceiling height (corridors, open areas).

void.description: Reserve this area but draw nothing (atrium, open air, the part of the podium a tower does not cover).
